=== ALL STAGE 1 NOTES FOR THE FRAME ===
--- NOTE: 0 Keepers of the Lamp.md ---
# 0 Keepers of the Lamp

A lighthouse is a promise made to ships. It burns whether or not a ship is near.[^1][^2]
The keeper kept that promise for the harbour.[^3]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "A lighthouse is a promise made to ships."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "It burns whether or not a ship is near."
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "The keeper kept that promise for the harbour."

--- NOTE: 1 The Keeper's Watch - Aside - The log.md ---
# 1 The Keeper's Watch - Aside - The log

The log was read by nobody until a ship was lost.[^1]
Then the inspectors read every page.[^2]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "The log was read by nobody until a ship was lost."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "Then the inspectors read every page."

--- NOTE: 1 The Keeper's Watch.md ---
# 1 The Keeper's Watch

The watch began at dusk.[^1]
He trimmed the wick every four hours.[^2]
He logged the weather in a book.[^3]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "The watch began at dusk."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "trimmed the wick every four hours"
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "logged the weather in a book"

--- NOTE: 2 The Lens.md ---
# 2 The Lens

The lens bends light into a beam.[^1]
A beam carries farther than a glow.[^2]
Obviously, a keeper can take no notice of the lens on a clear night.[^3]
On a foggy night it is no help at all.[^4]
It uses rings of prisms instead of one thick glass.[^5]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "The lens bends light into a beam."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "A beam carries farther than a glow."
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "Obviously, a keeper can take no notice of the lens on a clear night."
[^4]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "On a foggy night it is no help at all."
[^5]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "uses rings of prisms instead of one thick glass"

--- NOTE: 3 Storms.md ---
# 3 Storms

In a storm the light matters most.[^1]
A wreck was his failure, whatever the weather.[^2]
He stayed at the lamp (in 1839, for nine days) through every gale.[^3]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#Storms]] "In a storm the light matters most."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#Storms]] "failure, whatever the weather"
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#Storms]] "stayed at the lamp (in 1839, for nine days) through every gale"
